items.title: Open themed conversation
items.precondition: Isolated app runtime with two accepted-friend accounts.
steps: Confirm recent theme activity appears once in the timeline.
Keep the thread open for a fallback-poll interval with Socket.IO disabled.
items.expected: Initial theme history appears; polling preserves messages/theme but does not duplicate historical logs.
items.evidence: Automated typecheck passed; isolated browser runtime not started.

items.title: Inbox reaction and theme activity
steps: React to the peer’s message with Heart.
items.expected: Inbox reloads once per update, says reaction wording rather than 'Liked' for Heart, and shows the latest activity.

items.title: Concurrent theme writes
items.precondition: Disposable database and two authenticated participants.
items.expected: Both entries remain in newest-50 order without a lost update.
items.evidence: Model SQL reviewed and TypeScript typecheck passed; needs disposable-database integration execution.
items.notes: No test runner or disposable DB adapter exists in this branch.
